problems.title: Rationalise a limit
problems.question: Find $\lim_{x\to 0}(\sqrt{1+2x}-1)/(5x)$.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: Multiply by the conjugate to get $2/[5(\sqrt{1+2x}+1)]$.
steps: Substitute x=0 in this continuous simplified expression.

problems.title: An altitude from coordinates
problems.question: A=(3,5), B=(−1,8), C=(7,5). Find the altitude from C.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: $AB=5$, $AC=4$. The altitude from B to the horizontal AC is 3.
steps: The are a is 4·3/2=6. Thus the altitude from C to AB is 2·6/5.

problems.title: Differentiate a reciprocal root
problems.question: For $f(x)=18/\sqrt[3]x$, find f′(x).
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
steps: Differentiate: f′(x)=−6x^(−4/3), for x≠0.

problems.title: A sphere tangent to triangle sides
problems.question: A radius-6 sphere touches the three sides of a triangle with sides 15,15,24. Find its centre’s distance from the triangle plane.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: The triangle altitude is $\sqrt{15^2-12^2}=9$, are a 108, semiperimeter 27, so inradius $r=108/27=4$.
steps: The plane cuts the sphere in the incircle. If d is the plane distance, d²+r²=6², hence d²=20.

problems.title: Surface ratio of an inscribed sphere
problems.question: A cone frustum has base-radius ratio 2:3 and an inscribed sphere. Find sphere surface are a divided by frustum lateral are a.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: For radii R, r, the slant height is $R+r$ and sphere radius squared is $Rr$.
steps: The ratio is 4πRr/[π(R+r)²]=4·2·3/5².

problems.title: Derivative of a quotient
problems.question: For $f(x)=\arccos x/(x^2-1)$, find f′(0).
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: $f\prime=(u\prime v-uv\prime)/v^2$, $u\prime=-1/\sqrt{1-x^2}$.

problems.title: Product derivative
problems.question: Differentiate $e^x\cos x$.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: $(uv)\prime=u\prime v+uv\prime$, $(e^x)\prime=e^x$, $(\cos x)\prime=-\sin x$.
steps: Substitute and factor eˣ.

problems.title: Cylinder around a triangular prism
problems.question: A regular triangular prism has lateral are a S. Find the axial-section are a of its circumscribed cylinder.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: For base side a and height h, $S=3ah$, and the base circumradius is $a/\sqrt3$.
steps: The axial rectangle are a is 2ah/√3=2S/(3√3).
problems.note: Two printed choices give these equivalent expressions, so both are correct.

problems.title: Base-to-lateral area of a cone
problems.question: A cone has three pairwise perpendicular generators. Find base are a divided by lateral are a.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: For generator angle θ to the base, $3\sin^2\theta=1$ by the squared direction-cosine identity.
steps: Thus cos θ=√(2/3). The are a ratio is πr²/(πrl)=r/l=cos θ.

problems.title: Limit of a square root of cosine
problems.question: Find $\lim_{x\to 0}(\sqrt{\cos x}-1)/x$.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: The conjugate gives $(\cos x-1)/[x(\sqrt{\cos x}+1)]$.
steps: Use cos x−1=−2sin²(x/2). The numerator is of order x², while the denominator is of order x, so the limit is 0. More explicitly, sin(x/2)/(x/2)→1 leaves a factor x→0.

problems.title: A cotangent limit
problems.question: Find $\lim_{x\to 0}(1/x^2-\cot x/x)$.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: The fraction is $(\sin x-x\cos x)/(x^2\sin x)$.
steps: Taylor formulas give sin x=x−x³/6+O(x⁵), cos x=1−x²/2+O(x⁴). The numerator is x³/3+O(x⁵) and denominator x³+O(x⁵).

problems.title: Continuity along a sequence
problems.question: f is continuous and $f(1/n)=(5n^2+1)/(2n^2-2n+1)$. Find f(0).
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: Continuity gives $f(0)=\lim_{n\to\infty}f(1/n)$.
steps: Divide numerator and denominator by n². Their limits are 5 and 2.

problems.title: An exponential limit
problems.question: Find $\lim_{n\to\infty}((n+5)/(n+4))^{2n-1}$.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: Write the base $1+1/(n+4)$ and use $(1+1/m)^m\to e$.
steps: The exponent divided by n+4 tends to 2, so the limit is e².

problems.title: Implicit differentiation
problems.question: Differentiable f satisfies $f^3(x)+x^2f(x)+1=x$. Find f′(1).
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
steps: Differentiate: (3f²+x²)f′+2xf=1. Set x=1, f=0 to get f′(1)=1.

problems.title: Rationalise a sequence limit
problems.question: Find $\lim_{n\to\infty}(n-\sqrt{n^2+n+199})$.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: The conjugate gives $-(n+199)/(n+\sqrt{n^2+n+199})$.
steps: Divide by n. The limit is −1/(1+1).

problems.title: Rotate a trapezoid around its larger base
problems.question: An isosceles trapezoid has bases 4,6 and acute angle 60°. Rotate it around the larger base. Find volume.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: The end offset is $(6-4)/2=1$ and height $r=\tan60^\circ=\sqrt3$.
steps: The solid consists of a radius-√3 cylinder of length 4 and two radius-√3 cones each of height 1. Volume =π·3·4+2(π·3·1/3).

problems.title: An arctangent derivative as a limit
problems.question: If $\lim_{x\to\sqrt3}(3\arctan x-\pi)/(x-\sqrt3)=m/n$ in lowest terms, find m+n.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: The numerator vanishes at √3, and $(3\arctan x)\prime=3/(1+x^2)$.
steps: The limit is 3/4, hence m+n=7.

problems.title: Three sequence claims
problems.question: I: n¹⁹⁹¹⁹⁹/(1.0001)ⁿ→0. II: convergence of sin aₙ forces convergence of aₙ. III: convergence of aₙ forces convergence of sin aₙ. Which are true?
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: An exponential with base greater than 1 eventually dominates any fixed power; sine is continuous.
steps: I is true. II is false: take aₙ=2πn, whose sine is always 0 although aₙ diverges. III is true by continuity.

problems.title: Cylinder lateral area
problems.question: Two perpendicular vertical section planes meet along a cylinder generator. Their distances from the axis are 2.5,6. Height is 4. Find lateral are a.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
steps: The formula is 2πrh=2π·6.5·4.

problems.title: Rotate an obtuse isosceles triangle
problems.question: An isosceles triangle has apex angle 120°. It rotates about a line containing one equal side. Find solid surface are a divided by triangle are a.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: Let the equal side be l. The other equal side has perpendicular distance $r=l\sin120^\circ=\sqrt3l/2$ from the axis, and the base is $\sqrt3l$.
steps: Rotation produces two conical surfaces sharing a rim, with slant lengths l and √3l. Their total are a is πr(l+√3l). The triangle are a is l²sin120°/2=√3l²/4. Divide.

problems.title: A differentiable join
problems.question: f(x)=ax+b for x<1 and $x^4+x+1$ for x≥1. Find ab if f is differentiable everywhere.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: Continuity gives $a+b=3$; matching derivatives gives $a=4(1)^3+1=5$.
steps: Then b=−2, so ab=−10.

problems.title: Insphere of a rhombus-based pyramid
problems.question: A pyramid has rhombus base side 7 and altitude 4. All face apothems make angle α with the base, sinα=3/5. Its insphere surface are a is (a/b)π in lowest terms. Find a²+b².
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: The base inradius is 2, so height $h=2\tan\alpha=3/2$ and face apothem $l=2/\cos\alpha=5/2$.
steps: Base are a is 28 and lateral are a is (28/2)(5/2)=35. Volume is 28·(3/2)/3=14. Using V=rS/3 gives r=42/63=2/3. Sphere are a is 4πr²=16π/9, so a=16, b=9.

problems.title: Differentiability at zero
problems.question: For nonzero x let $f(x)=\sqrt[3]x\sin(1/x)$, $g(x)=x\sin(1/x)$, $h(x)=x^2\sin(1/x)$; each is 0 at 0. Which is differentiable there?
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: At zero the difference quotients are $x^{-2/3}\sin(1/x)$, $\sin(1/x)$, and $x\sin(1/x)$.
steps: The first has no finite limit; along positive x with sine 1 it becomes unbounded. The second oscillates. The third tends to 0 because its absolute value is at most |x|.

problems.title: An integer product in a recurrence
problems.question: $a_1=1, a_2=\sqrt[7]2, a_n=a_{n-1}a_{n-2}^2$. Find the least k>1 for which the first k terms have integer product.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
steps: The first b values are 0,1,1,3,5,11. Their partial sums for k=2,…,6 are 1,2,5,10,21. The product is integer exactly when this sum is divisible by 7; the first is 21.

problems.title: Reflect a line across y=x
problems.question: Reflect 3x+5y−16=0 across x−y=0. Find its equation.
problems.idea: Apply the defining formula and simplify carefully.
formulas: Reflection across y=x swaps x and y.
steps: Replace x by y and y by x in the original equation.
